purpose: Canonical architectural spine for the DEM Architecture Explorer. This is the architectural source model; repository evidence is attached to nodes and edges rather than driving the top-level taxonomy.
governing_principle: Intelligent Operating Platform first; Digital Export Manager is the first executive intelligence persona; repository evidence proves and refines the model.

layers.name: Digital Export Manager
layers.role: Executive intelligence persona through which human employees interact with the platform.

cross_cutting_boundaries.name: External Research
cross_cutting_boundaries.boundary: Must remain distinct from Company Knowledge ingestion.

classification_rules.runtime: requires runtime wiring evidence; repository presence alone is insufficient
classification_rules.implemented_but_not_wired: code exists but no active runtime path has been proven
classification_rules.conditional: runtime path depends on configuration or credentials
classification_rules.planned: documented future intent without current implementation
classification_rules.reserved: repository structure exists without completed runtime semantics

graph_contract.evidence_rule: Every architectural assertion must be traceable to repository code or governing project documentation.
graph_contract.identity_rule: English technical names preserve code identity; Arabic provides functional meaning.
graph_contract.boundary_rule: The graph must explain what each layer owns and what it must not do.
graph_contract.no_inference_rule: Imports, directory presence, or naming alone do not prove runtime invocation.

next_work: Populate and validate this canonical spine from existing repository evidence, then extend it downward to L3 without creating separate reconciliation documents.
